classification: LOCAL DESIGN/TUNING EVIDENCE; NOT FINAL AWS HD EVIDENCE

assumptionNotes.service: Fixed-arm three-run mean. Assumes linear task capacity; D does not establish a per-task multi-worker throughput law.
assumptionNotes.reactive: 62.512 s is from the first genuine above-target BPT minute to the single valid fast-reactive retest request. The model adds this delay after a simulated 60 s sample; actual alarm phase and metric lag vary.
assumptionNotes.startup: 40.047 s is the slowest of four request-to-WORKER_READY intervals in the single valid retest. Observed range is 32.390–40.047 s.
assumptionNotes.queue: Simplified fluid-capacity FIFO model; no SQS polling, network, Lambda, or AWS control-plane variability. BPT here is modelled backlog/running, not genuine CloudWatch data.
